title: Product-owner field test repair and closed-loop diagnostics
scope: Repair the Build 51 technician workflow findings from live iPhone testing and implement migration-safe closed-loop diagnostic evidence, corrections, retests, and completion.
objectives: Implement durable structured diagnostic states, test results, corrections, retests, comparisons, and terminal outcomes.
Repair Operating Context touch/persistence and mobile New Job interaction.
Carry New Job chassis identity forward, allow honestly missing sourced submodels, and add an unverified custom pre-1984 path.
Add normalized carburetor type-ahead while separating identification from compatibility.
Add structured run-on evidence, repair visible encoding defects, and migrate current guidance vocabulary to Beginner, Seasoned, and Pro without losing legacy Novice history.
Add browser-level acceptance coverage and preserve prior behavior, vehicle provenance, and CT-0054 audit integrity.
constraints: Do not fabricate historical vehicle or component compatibility records.
Do not build PostgreSQL, a Knowledge Harvester backend, or a general AI/NLP service.
Do not weaken tests, discard saved jobs, alter CT-0054 audit history, or add secrets/customer data.
Do not change application functionality outside the assigned field-test repairs.

acceptanceTests.expected: Field-test vehicle, mobile, touch, carb identification, and encoding findings are repaired with browser evidence.
Structured tests/results change state, corrections produce retests/comparisons, override concerns remain honest, and diagnosis terminates.
Guidance migration, prior audit compatibility, conditional AFR, relational vehicle protection, and prior regressions remain green.
